about:
Risen Medical, LLC was founded in 2017 in the greater Portland, Oregon metropolitan area and now operates from Bend, Oregon. The company was established to serve physicians and their patients, with team members located across Oregon, Idaho, and Washington.

The company provides a range of medical technology and services to clinics, including multiple spine surgical systems, spine implants, biologic and bone graft products, and durable medical equipment (DME) services such as bone growth stimulation, bracing, and CPAP therapy. Risen Medical partners with suppliers like Aspen Medical Products, Orthofix Medical, Advanced Orthopedics, React Health, and Fisher & Paykel to offer CPAP/APAP devices, bone growth therapy, cold therapy, continuous passive motion units, spine hardware, and spine navigation systems.

Risen Medical serves orthopedic and spine surgery clinics, sleep therapy providers, and broader healthcare facilities in the Pacific Northwest. Its customer base includes physicians and clinics seeking integrated DME solutions and surgical implant support.

The company states its mission is achieving optimum patient outcomes by providing cutting‑edge medical technology and service to providers and patients, positioning itself as a valuable addition to clinic teams.
